title: Visa Officer
description:
***Job Title: Case Officer***




***Department : Operations \- Business Immigration***




***Reporting To: Senior Case Officer / Operations Manager***




***Employment Type: Full\-Time***




  





**Position Summary:\-** 




 The Case Officer \- L\-1A Business Immigration is responsible for managing L\-1A business immigration cases from initiation through petition filing. The role involves evaluating client
 



 eligibility, understanding business operations, coordinating with multiple internal departments,
 



 drafting immigration documentation, reviewing supporting evidence, maintaining client
 



 communication, and ensuring that complete, high\-quality petitions are prepared for submission
 



 to USCIS. The Case Officer acts as the central coordinator between clients and internal teams
 



 to ensure every case is accurate, compliant, and submitted within prescribed timelines.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:\-** 




  





**1\. Client Eligibility Assessment \& Case Initiation:\-** 



* Conduct initial assessment of prospective L\-1A cases to determine eligibility based on business structure, ownership, managerial capacity, qualifying relationship, and operational requirements.
* Analyze the client's existing business model, industry, organizational hierarchy, and expansion objectives to determine appropriate case strategy.
* Review available documentation and identify additional evidence required for successful petition preparation.
* Explain documentation requirements and procedural timelines to clients during the onboarding stage.



  





**2\. End\-to\-End Case Management:\-** 



* Manage assigned L\-1A petitions from document collection through final filing.
* Prepare and maintain case plans, document trackers, and internal progress reports.
* Monitor timelines and ensure milestones are achieved within scheduled deadlines.
* Coordinate all internal activities required for timely petition preparation.



  





**3\. Document Collection \& Client Coordination:\-** 



* Collect corporate, financial, operational, employment, and legal documentation from clients.
* Regularly communicate with clients regarding pending documents and clarification requests.
* Verify the completeness, authenticity, and consistency of documents received.
* Maintain organized digital case files and document repositories.



  





**4\. Business Analysis \& Documentation:\-** 



* Develop a comprehensive understanding of the client's Indian business, including operations,



 products or services, management structure, revenue model, and future expansion plans.
 


* Draft company profiles, business summaries, organizational descriptions, managerial narratives,



 and operational documentation relating to the Indian entity.
 


* Review business records to ensure all supporting evidence accurately reflects the client's actual



 business operations.
 


* Ensure documentation aligns with USCIS requirements and overall petition strategy.



  





**5\. Coordination with Business Plan Team:\-** 



* Coordinate with the Business Plan Team to provide complete business information required for



 preparation of U.S. business plans.
 


* Share operational data, financial inputs, organizational information, hiring plans, investment



 details, and business objectives.
 


* Review draft business plans to ensure consistency with the petition narrative and supporting



 documentation.
 


* Coordinate revisions whenever inconsistencies or additional requirements are identified.



  





**6\. Drafting Immigration Documents:\-** 



* Prepare L\-1A immigration documentation, including support letters, organizational explanations,



 management narratives, job descriptions, company summaries, qualifying relationship documents,
 



 and other supporting materials.
 


* Draft explanatory letters and supporting documents required for petition preparation.
* Ensure all drafted documentation is internally consistent and factually accurate.



  





**7\. Internal Coordination:\-** 



* Coordinate with the Graphics Team for preparation of organizational charts, company structure



 diagrams, office layouts, marketing materials, presentation graphics, and other visual evidence
 



 supporting the petition.
 


* Work closely with document preparation, quality control, legal, and management teams



 throughout the case lifecycle.
 


* Facilitate timely resolution of documentation queries across departments.



  





**8\. Quality Control \& Documentation Review:\-** 



* Perform comprehensive quality checks of all petition documents before submission.
* Review drafted documents for accuracy, completeness, formatting consistency, grammar, and



 compliance with internal quality standards.
 


* Cross\-verify information across all supporting documents to eliminate discrepancies.
* Ensure financial records, corporate documents, organizational charts, employment records, and



 business plans remain consistent throughout the petition
 



  





**9\. Petition Preparation \& Filing:\-** 



* Assemble complete L\-1A petition packages in accordance with USCIS filing requirements.
* Prepare Form I\-129 and all applicable L classification supporting documentation.
* Verify that all mandatory forms, exhibits, supporting evidence, and filing documents are included



 prior to submission.
 


* Coordinate final review and filing of petitions with senior management.



  





**10\. Case Documentation \& Compliance:\-** 



* Maintain complete electronic and physical case records throughout the lifecycle of each petition.
* Ensure all confidential client information is handled in accordance with company policies.
* Update internal case management systems with accurate case progress and documentation



 status.
 


* Stay informed regarding USCIS policy updates, L\-1A regulations, filing requirements, and documentation standards.



  





**Required Skills:\-** 



* Strong understanding of U.S. L\-1A Business Immigration processes.
* Excellent business analysis and documentation skills.
* Strong drafting and technical writing ability.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* High attention to detail with strong quality control capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously.
* Strong communication and client coordination skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and document management software.

 Develop and support business plans related to contracts, focusing on efficiency and effectiveness.
   

  

 Possess expertise in various contract types, including fixed\-price, cost\-reimbursable, time and materials, and performance\-based contracts.
   

  

 Apply knowledge to manage and modify contracts according to their specific structure.
   

  

**Research And Analysis**
 Undertake comprehensive research on market trends, best practices, and benchmarks relevant to contracts and service delivery. Oversee the preparation and processing of Non\-Financial Assessments (NFA), ensuring all necessary documentation is complete and accurate.
   

  

 Gather data and insights to support decision\-making processes for Service Development and Contract Managers.
   

  

**Performance Monitoring And Reporting**
 Monitor, collate, and analyze contract performance information, producing detailed reports to track contract compliance and effectiveness.
   

  

 Create and maintain weekly and monthly performance dashboards, presenting data in a clear and actionable format for management review and decision\-making.
   

  

 Prepare and submit financial documents as required by the Airports Economic Regulatory Authority (AERA), ensuring accuracy and adherence to regulatory timelines.
   

  

**Regulatory Compliance And Risk Assessment**
 Ensure that all contracts comply with legal and regulatory requirements, as well as company policies and procedures and monitor compliance with contractual obligations and address any issues promptly to avoid legal or financial repercussions.
   

  

 Analyze risks associated with specific contract terms, providing recommendations for mitigation strategies.
   

  

**Tender Management**
 Assist in the preparation and submission of tenders by accurately identifying the Bill of Quantities (BOQ) and defining the scope of work, ensuring clarity for potential contractors.
   

  

 Manage the contractor selection process by floating tenders, facilitating negotiations with bidders, and verifying all submitted documentation for compliance ensuring selection of qualified contractors who meet project requirements effectively.
   

  

**Claim Management**
 Oversee the management of claims related to contracts, ensuring they are resolved in a timely and efficient manner.
   

  

 Coordinate with relevant departments and legal teams to assess, negotiate, and settle claims while minimizing financial and operational impact.

title: Compliance and Operations - Treasury
description:
**Brief of role :** 




 To support and manage day\-to\-day treasury operations, including repayment planning, borrowing and limit monitoring, asset allocation, DA payouts, NACH coordination, banking activities, treasury MIS, liquidity risk management, and regulatory/compliance requirements.
 



 The role will ensure
 **accurate, timely, and well\-controlled treasury transactions** 
 , effective utilisation of borrowing facilities, proper reconciliation of financial data, and seamless coordination with banks, internal stakeholders, auditors, and other external agencies.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:\-** 




  





 1\.Repayment \& Borrowing Management
 


* Prepare and maintain repayment schedules covering principal, interest, and other applicable charges.
* Coordinate with banks and internal teams for timely processing of repayments.
* Ensure repayment data is accurately recorded and reconciled with books, bank statements, and internal MIS.
* Monitor upcoming repayment obligations and highlight funding requirements in advance.
* Support management in effective utilisation and monitoring of borrowing facilities.



  





 2\. DA Payout \& Transaction Management
 


* Coordinate DA payouts and ensure timely processing of transactions.
* Validate transaction calculations and supporting documentation before processing.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams and banking partners for transaction closure.
* Resolve transaction\-related discrepancies and queries.
* Provide necessary support during internal and external audits.



  





 3\. Treasury MIS \& Data Validation
 


* Prepare daily, monthly, and periodic Treasury MIS.
* Maintain MIS covering Borrowings,Repayments,Cash flows,Disbursements,Collection Efficiency,Portfolio cuts,Other key treasury parameters
* Obtain and validate data from various internal teams.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely submission of MIS.
* Reconcile MIS data with books of accounts and relevant source documents.



  





 4\. Asset Allocation \& Reconciliation
 


* Monitor allocation of assets against respective funding facilities and transactions.
* Ensure proper mapping of assets to borrowing/funding arrangements.
* Conduct periodic reconciliation of asset allocation.
* Identify and resolve mismatches, excess allocation, or double allocation.
* Maintain appropriate records and supporting documentation.



  





 5\. Compliance Management
 


* Track and complete monthly and quarterly treasury\-related compliance requirements within prescribed timelines.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams, banks, auditors, and other stakeholders for required data and documents.
* Ensure timely submission of certificates, statements, reports, and supporting documents.
* Maintain a compliance tracker and proactively highlight pending or upcoming requirements.
* Support activities related to Liquidity Risk Management.
* Assist in preparation and monitoring of liquidity\-related reports and data.
* Track cash inflows and outflows and support assessment of liquidity requirements.
* Highlight potential liquidity gaps and upcoming funding requirements to the relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure timely availability and accuracy of data required for LRM reporting.



  





 6\. NACH Coordination
 


* Coordinate with the Operations team for NACH mandate setup and activation.
* Ensure mandates are processed and made live within defined timelines.
* Monitor mandate\-related issues and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution.
* Provide ongoing operational support for NACH\-related requirements.
* Assist in opening and activating new bank accounts as per business requirements.
* Coordinate KYC, documentation, account activation, and related formalities.
* Maintain appropriate records of bank accounts and ensure correct mapping.
* Coordinate execution of required documentation for API/banking integrations.
* Liaise with banks and internal stakeholders for account\-related requirements.



  





 7\. Limit Utilisation Monitoring
 


* Monitor sanctioned, utilised, and available limits across various borrowing facilities.
* Maintain facility\-wise limit utilisation records.
* Ensure timely reporting of utilisation levels to relevant stakeholders.
* Proactively highlight excess utilisation, low availability, or upcoming limit requirements.
* Support effective utilisation of available borrowing limits.



  





 8\. Annexure 1 \& Regulatory Reporting
 


* Prepare and submit Annexure 1 within prescribed timelines.
* Validate underlying data before submission.
* Ensure figures are accurate and reconciled with books of accounts and Treasury MIS.
* Coordinate with relevant teams for data and supporting documents.
* Maintain proper records for audit and future reference.



  





 9\. Audit \& Internal Controls
 


* Support internal, statutory, lender, and other audits relating to treasury activities.
* Provide required documents, reconciliations, schedules, and transaction details.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations related to treasury operations.
* Follow established treasury processes, controls, and approval mechanisms.



  





 10\. Other Treasury Activities
 


* Support management in treasury\-related analysis, reporting, and decision\-making.
* Undertake any other treasury\-related activities or projects assigned from time to time.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve treasury processes, controls, reporting, and operational efficiency.



  





**Desired Skills :\-** 



* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Finance, CA Inter, CMA Inter, or equivalent qualification will be an added advantage.



  





**Preferred:** 



* Strong understanding of treasury operations, banking, borrowings, cash flow, and financial reconciliations.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel and financial MIS
* **2–5 years** 
 of relevant experience in Treasury, Finance, Banking, NBFC, or Financial Services.
